messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah@acuity.health>, Markus Holt <markus.holt@acuity.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Locking 75m ML/Infra Deep Dive + attendee responsibilities

Thanks again for taking the time today — really valuable discussion on your high-throughput inference patterns and cost sensitivities. Per our call, next best step is a focused ML/Infra deep dive (60–90 minutes) with our infra leads so we can:

- Walk through your production traffic profile and target SLAs
- Show expected latency/cost tradeoffs with our batching/caching configs
- Review networking and security expectations for a Private deployment

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 16, 09:00–10:15 (75m)
- Wed May 17, 13:00–14:15 (75m)
- Thu May 18, 08:30–09:45 (75m)

Attached: tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (draft agenda) and precall-questions.xlsx (short questionnaire for your infra team). Please let me know which slot works and who from your side will join (names + roles).

High level ask from our side: please include 1x technical lead (networking/infra), 1x ML lead (serving/ops) if possible. We’ll bring our infra/serving engineers and a brief runbook.

If these slots don't work, share 2-3 alternatives and we'll align.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: precall-questions.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the materials. Good to see this level of focus. A few notes: 

- Our core attendees will be me (Head of ML Ops), Markus Holt (Platform Lead), and Lynn Park (CTO) — Lynn prefers to join for the first 30–45 minutes to set context.
- We need the deep dive to start no later than 09:00 PT on the day we pick due to other commitments. The Tue May 16 slot looks promising for us.
- Can you make sure someone from your security/compliance team can cover data handling & VPC specifics? We have a short SOC-2 checklist we'd like to run through.
- Recording is okay, and we'll expect a short list of pre-reads for the ML team.

Proposed preference: Tue May 16, 09:00–10:15 PT. If you can tentatively hold that, I’ll confirm with Lynn and Markus and accept the calendar invite after we align.

Thanks,
Sarah
